gauges.provenance: gauge_declared: uniaxial X-leg gauge of the pinned compiled tetra; L0 = 0.100 m (X-leg rest length) and A = 5.0e-3 m^2 (exact area of the tetrahedron face perpendicular to X, recomputed from the pinned mesh blob vertices and cross-checked); support = pinned x-min face (visible in every capture); load applied at the x-max vertex, compressive. Authored experiment rig (synthetic), not a source-measured cross-section.

profiles.constitutive_equation: x = 0 for any load in range; transmits F_out = F_in exactly; U = Q = 0
profiles.rest_state: no strain state exists; rest geometry is the only geometry

profiles.constitutive_equation: elastic x_el = F/k, k = E*A/L0; series dashpot: dF/dt = k*v - F/tau, tau = c/k; hold decay F(t) = F_ramp*exp(-t/tau); creep x(t) = F/k + F*t/c
profiles.rest_state: zero applied load: extension 0, force 0, stored 0, dissipated 0; current geometry == rest geometry

profiles.constitutive_equation: E(theta) = E_trans + (E_fiber - E_trans)*cos^2(theta); elastic x = F*L0/(A*E(theta)); k = E(theta)*A/L0
profiles.rest_state: zero applied load: extension 0, force 0, stored 0, dissipated 0; current geometry == rest geometry

assignments.provenance: isotropic compliant matrix profile on the pinned tetra gauge (synthetic modulus E=5e5 Pa; no source modulus admitted for monkey tissue)

provenance.rotated_fiber_note: the tetra carries three declared fiber directions (0/45/90 deg about world Z) used by the E3 rotated-fiber experiment; each direction row is assigned in experiments, not simultaneously
provenance.plate_note: the plate keeps its pinned M02 geometry and authored thickness; only its pinned two-triangle areas feed the area-scaled interface oracle (P7) — no plate gauge, no plate deformation claim
provenance.density_note: matter masses/densities are M02 pinned data; they are never inputs to stiffness, force, extension or energy
